title: Zeros user settings
description: User-wide Zeros settings (~/.zeros/settings.toml). Includes user-only keys (models, workspaces, tool approvals) that repository settings may not set.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete.

setup.description: Runs when a workspace is created.

run.description: LEGACY single run command — superseded by run_actions (it migrates to one default action at read time when run_actions is absent; an explicit run_actions list, even empty, wins).

id.description: Stable id — the session-id suffix + status key.

name.description: Label shown on the tab / menu / button.

icon.description: Lucide icon name (curated set; unknown falls back to play).

platforms.description: OSes this action shows on. Absent/empty = all.

one_shot.description: true → run to completion for a pass/fail verdict; false → long-lived (dev server). Absent = heuristic by command.

run_on_create.description: Start automatically when a workspace is created.

default.description: The header split-button face + primary shortcut.

run_actions.description: Named run actions — multiple concurrent run commands, each with an icon. Supersedes the single `run` string (which migrates to one default action at read time).

archive.description: Runs before a workspace is archived.

run_mode.description: Whether run scripts of multiple workspaces may run at once.

auto_run_after_setup.description: Start the run script automatically after setup.

remote.description: Git remote new workspaces branch from.

branch_prefix_type.description: Which namespace a new workspace branch goes under: "github" = the connected GitHub login (the default), "custom" = the `branch_prefix` string, "none" = no prefix (the bare workspace name), "zeros" = the fixed `zeros/` namespace. The namespace is joined to the name with a single `/`.

branch_prefix.description: The namespace used when branch_prefix_type = "custom". Joined to the workspace name with a single `/`, so `acme` gives `acme/Cream`. A leading or trailing slash is optional and ignored.

archive_on_merge.description: Archive a workspace automatically when its PR merges.

directory.description: Repo-relative folder the design surface reads and writes (default "Zeros Design"). The folder is committed content; this key just selects which design folder is active.

env.description: Non-secret environment variables passed to agents.

env_files.description: Env files parsed at spawn time; values never enter TOML.

file_include_globs.description: Gitignored files matching these patterns are seeded into each new worktree (e.g. ".env*"). Gitignore syntax, including "!" to exclude. Set here for every project, or in a repo's .zeros/settings.local.toml for one project; a repo-root .worktreeinclude file, if present, takes precedence over both.

command.description: Executable to spawn for the stdio server.

env.description: Environment variables for the server process (non-secret / refs).

enabled.description: Set false to keep the entry but skip loading it.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent on every request (e.g. Authorization; non-secret / refs). Applies to auth="none" (injected directly) and auth="header" (sent alongside the brokered secret); IGNORED for auth="oauth" (the gateway manages the connection).

auth.description: Routes this server through the Zeros MCP gateway: "oauth" brokers OAuth 2.1 once and holds the token; "header" holds a static auth header (its VALUE lives in the engine vault, never here) and adds it when proxying. Default "none" = injected directly with the headers above.

header_name.description: For auth="header": the header NAME the gateway sets (e.g. Authorization). The value is stored in the engine secret vault, not this file.

oauth_client_id.description: For auth="oauth": a pre-registered OAuth client_id for servers that don't support Dynamic Client Registration (Auth0/Okta/Cognito/enterprise). Non-secret. Omit to auto-register (DCR).

disabled_tools.description: For a gateway-fronted server (auth oauth/header): tool NAMES to hide from agents — e.g. to stay under Cursor's ~40-tool cap. Empty/absent = all tools exposed.

enabled.description: Set false to keep the entry but skip loading it.

servers.description: MCP servers shared across every agent.

default_agent.description: Agent the default model belongs to. Disambiguates a model id that's shared across agents or whose value embeds another family's name.

default_fast_mode.description: Legacy global Fast default (migration input for the selected model).

default_plan_mode.description: Start new chats in plan mode.

favorites.description: Legacy favorite model id per agent family (migration input).

agent.description: Canonical agent family, or extension agent id, that owns this model.

effort.description: Last reasoning effort selected for this exact model.

fast.description: Last Fast-mode selection for this exact model.

agent.description: Canonical agent family, or extension agent id, that owns this model.

effort.description: Last reasoning effort selected for this exact model.

fast.description: Last Fast-mode selection for this exact model.

model_preferences.description: Bounded per-model reasoning and Fast-mode memory. Entries are isolated by agent family and exact model id.

agent.description: Canonical agent family, or extension agent id, that owns this permission choice.

permission_preferences.description: Bounded per-agent permission-mode memory. Exact native ids preserve modes that share the same coarse posture.

chat_title_model.description: Model used to generate chat titles.

default_effort_level.description: Legacy Claude-family effort (migration input for the selected model).

fallback_model.description: Fallback Claude model id, or the sentinel "none" to fail fast.

budget_cap_usd.description: Optional maximum Claude spend in USD per turn.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: How long an idle Claude session stays warm (30 minutes to 5 hours).

auto_memory_enabled.description: Allow Claude Code to maintain its native repository memory.

default_thinking_level.description: Legacy Codex-family effort (migration input for the selected model).

path.description: Root folder where new worktrees are created.

enabled.description: Legacy fallback for provider-specific browser integration switches.

codex_enabled.description: Enable Codex browser use in the in-app Chromium tab.

claude_enabled.description: Enable Claude's official external Chrome integration.

provider.description: In-app host backend for native Codex IAB. Currently supports isolated only.

auto_open.description: Reveal the Browser workbench tab when an active agent opens a page.

show_agent_cursor.description: Show the short-lived agent pointer inside the shared browser page.

navigation_approval.description: Whether agents ask before opening a website. Consequential actions remain separately gated.

auth_method.description: The GitHub credential method Zeros actively uses.

disconnected_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last explicit disconnect; prevents implicit credential adoption.
